name: Steven Universe
description: A young boy takes his mother's place in a group of gemstone-based beings, and must learn to control his powers.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Steven gets a hold of a magical time travel device and does what any kid would do - he uses it for comebacks. But toying with magic draws trouble to his sleepy beach town and Steven has to step up and save the day - with more comebacks.

videos.title: Lion Loves to Fit in a Box
videos.overview: Lion unsuccessfully attempts to get into various boxes.

videos.title: The Classroom Gems: What Are Gems?
videos.overview: Pearl teaches Steven about Gems, with some demonstrations from Garnet and Amethyst.

videos.title: We Are the Crystal Gems
videos.overview: Young Steven moves in with the three Crystal Gems, as the extended version of the title theme and second opening sequence shows.

videos.title: The Classroom Gems: How Are Gems Made?
videos.overview: Amethyst tells Steven how Gems are made.

videos.title: Unboxing
videos.overview: Steven creates a video where he receives and unboxes a new Hot Dog duffel bag from the Wacky Sack company.

videos.title: The Classroom Gems: Special Lesson
videos.overview: Garnet takes over a dance studio to demonstrate to Steven how fusion works.

videos.title: Cooking with Lion
videos.overview: Steven and Lion host an educational online cooking show.

videos.title: Gem Karaoke
videos.overview: Connie documents Steven and the Gems singing their hearts out to a pre-recorded backing track.

videos.title: Steven Reacts
videos.overview: Steven reacts live to a brand new episode of his favorite cartoon show.

videos.title: Video Chat
videos.overview: Steven and Peridot introduce Lapis to a new way to communicate.

videos.title: Steven's Song Time
videos.overview: Steven teaches you how to play a new song he wrote.

videos.title: The Series So Far
videos.overview: Steven Universe fills you in on everything you need to know about Rose Quartz, The Crystal Gems, and The Diamond Authority before you dive into any new episodes! (And there might just be a sneak peek of what’s to come...)

videos.title: Steven Universe: The Movie
videos.overview: After so many harrowing adventures, Steven and the Gems are ready to celebrate how far they've come with a movie musical! Little do they know they're about to face their worst enemy yet.

videos.title: Gem Glow
videos.overview: Steven gets depressed when his favorite ice-cream sandwich brand, Cookie Cat, has been taken off the market. He soon cheers up when the Gems manage to get a hold of some of the last remaining Cookie Cats, which Steven believes may hold the key to activating his gem.

videos.title: Laser Light Cannon
videos.overview: When a menacing red eye is about to hit Beach City, the only thing that can destroy it is a Laser Light Cannon which once belonged to Steven's mother, Rose Quartz. Thus, Steven enlists the help of his father, Greg, and they search through his storage for the cannon.

videos.title: Cheeseburger Backpack
videos.overview: The Gems go on a mission to place a Moon Goddess statue on top of the ruined Lunar Sea Spire, and Steven tries to prove he can be useful with the help of his new novelty cheeseburger backpack.

videos.title: Together Breakfast
videos.overview: Steven's attempt to get the Gems to share his special breakfast tradition lands him on a journey through their ancient Gem temple.

videos.title: Frybo
videos.overview: Steven brings a mascot costume to life with a magic shard owned by Pearl to help his friend Peedee with his job, but it backfires when the mascot goes rogue.

videos.title: Cat Fingers
videos.overview: Steven tries to master his shapeshifting abilities from Amethyst, but turns his fingers into cats, making it harder to do things.

videos.title: Bubble Buddies
videos.overview: Steven creates a magic bubble around himself and a girl he likes, Connie, to save her from a falling rock, but has no idea how to make it disappear.

videos.title: Serious Steven
videos.overview: While navigating out of an ancient Gem maze, Steven tries to prove himself worthy to Garnet by being serious.

videos.title: Tiger Millionaire
videos.overview: Steven joins an underground wrestling league with Amethyst, who is tired of Pearl and Garnet bringing her down.

videos.title: Steven's Lion
videos.overview: Steven befriends a magical lion he finds in the desert during a mission with the Gems.

videos.title: Arcade Mania
videos.overview: Steven takes the Gems on his own kind of adventure by bringing them to the Fun Land Arcade, where Garnet soon becomes enchanted by a dancing game.

videos.title: Giant Woman
videos.overview: Steven urges Amethyst and Pearl to fuse together into a four-armed "giant woman" named Opal (Aimee Mann). Amethyst and Pearl, however, keep on quarrelling.

videos.title: So Many Birthdays
videos.overview: After learning that the Gems are thousands of years old, Steven decides to make up for all the birthdays they've missed.

videos.title: Lars and the Cool Kids
videos.overview: Steven and Lars get to hang out with the cool kids (Jenny Pizza, Buck Dewey and Sour Cream) in town, but their teenage shenanigans get them into magical trouble.

videos.title: Onion Trade
videos.overview: A toy trade between Steven and Onion escalates into epic proportions.

videos.title: Steven the Sword Fighter
videos.overview: Pearl gets injured and retreats into her gem to heal and make a new body to project after she tries to teach Steven the art of sword-fighting using a holographic version of herself.

videos.title: Lion 2: The Movie
videos.overview: Steven and Connie try to ride Lion to the movie theater, but Lion has other plans.

videos.title: Beach Party
videos.overview: After a battle damages the Fish Stew Pizza sign, the Gems are banned from the restaurant, so Steven throws a cookout on the beachside to mend the relationship between the Pizza family and the Gems.

videos.title: Rose's Room
videos.overview: Steven's desire for some alone time unlocks a new room in the Temple that answers his every wish.

videos.title: Coach Steven
videos.overview: Against Pearl's wishes, Steven becomes determined to get stronger after watching Garnet and Amethyst fuse into the mighty Sugilite.

videos.title: Joking Victim
videos.overview: Steven works at the Big Donut when Lars leaves Sadie with all the work.

videos.title: Steven and the Stevens
videos.overview: Steven needs a musical partner for an upcoming show, so he uses a time travel device to recruit himself as the perfect bandmate.

videos.title: Monster Buddies
videos.overview: Steven attempts to tame a monster's wild form when he accidentally releases it from its gem bubble.

videos.title: An Indirect Kiss
videos.overview: Steven tells Connie about his mission with the Gems to heal Amethyst after she cracks her gemstone.

videos.title: Mirror Gem
videos.overview: Steven befriends a magical mirror that can mysteriously communicate with only him and ends up setting free its trapped inhabitant, a Gem named Lapis Lazuli.

videos.title: Ocean Gem
videos.overview: Lapis Lazuli disappears after reigniting a past conflict with Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl, and takes the ocean along with her, leaving Beach City in a panic on the first day of summer. Steven, Connie, Greg, Lion and the Gems go on a mission to confront Lapis and set things back to normal.

videos.title: House Guest
videos.overview: Left homeless and with a broken leg after the events of the previous episode, Greg stays with Steven and the Gems as a temporary house guest and unintentionally interferes with Steven's healing powers.

videos.title: Space Race
videos.overview: Steven, Pearl and Greg work together to build a spaceship so that Pearl can revisit the wonders of the cosmos, but Pearl gets a little carried away.

videos.title: Secret Team
videos.overview: After they accidentally pop a bubble containing gem shards, Steven, Amethyst and Pearl form a secret team to retrieve the shards before Garnet finds out.

videos.title: Island Adventure
videos.overview: Steven tries to mend Lars' and Sadie's friendship by taking them on vacation to a magical beach.

videos.title: Keep Beach City Weird!
videos.overview: Steven is taken in by Ronaldo's conspiracy theories about paranormal occurrences in Beach City.

videos.title: Fusion Cuisine
videos.overview: Steven asks the Gems to fuse together and pretend to be his mother at dinner with Connie's family.

videos.title: Garnet's Universe
videos.overview: Steven interprets what Garnet did during the day after a recent mission.

videos.title: Watermelon Steven
videos.overview: Steven grows a patch of watermelons shaped like himself, but they soon come to life and attack people.

videos.title: Lion 3: Straight to Video
videos.overview: Lion keeps lying on Steven's face while he's sleeping. This leads to Steven discovering a pocket dimension in Lion's mane.

videos.title: Warp Tour
videos.overview: Steven becomes uneasy after seeing an unknown object traversing through a warp stream, despite the Gems' attempts to disprove his claims.

videos.title: Alone Together
videos.overview: While practicing how to fuse with Gems, Steven accidentally fuses with Connie, forming a half-human and half-Gem, human fusion called Stevonnie.

videos.title: The Test
videos.overview: Steven finds out that the Lunar Sea Spire mission from the third episode was a test and demands a new one.

videos.title: Future Vision
videos.overview: Steven learns that Garnet can see into the future and becomes paranoid about the possible dangers around him.

videos.title: On the Run
videos.overview: Steven and Amethyst try life out on the road. During so, Amethyst reveals a dark secret about herself and the Gems to Steven.

videos.title: Horror Club
videos.overview: Steven goes to the lighthouse to watch scary movies with Ronaldo, Lars and Sadie.

videos.title: Winter Forecast
videos.overview: Steven has to take Connie back to her home before a blizzard hits Beach City, and Garnet shows him some outcomes before they leave.

videos.title: Maximum Capacity
videos.overview: While cleaning out Greg's storage unit, Greg and Amethyst are reunited with their favorite sitcom Li'l Butler.

videos.title: Marble Madness
videos.overview: When several droids from space descend towards warp pad zones, Steven and the Gems attempt to track down their purposes.

videos.title: Rose's Scabbard
videos.overview: Pearl takes Steven to a special place that belonged to Rose Quartz after Lion finds the scabbard for Rose's sword.

videos.title: The Message
videos.overview: Steven and the Gems need Greg's help to retrieve a message from the Wailing Stone.

videos.title: Political Power
videos.overview: The Gems cause a power outage in Beach City, and Steven helps Mayor Dewey with damage control.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Peridot and her new partner, Jasper, arrive on Earth.

videos.title: Jail Break
videos.overview: Trapped on Peridot's ship, Steven attempts to rescue the Gems from the Homeworld's clutches, including two Gems named Ruby and Sapphire.

videos.title: Full Disclosure
videos.overview: Steven tries to avoid Connie so he won't have to tell her about his ordeal with the Homeworld Gems from the previous episodes.

videos.title: Open Book
videos.overview: When Connie is upset by the ending of her favorite book series, Steven takes her to Rose Quartz's room, where they remake the ending.

videos.title: Joy Ride
videos.overview: Buck, Jenny and Sour Cream take Steven out on a late-night joyride to lift his spirits and teach him how to have fun, until they end up discovering Peridot's escape pod.

videos.title: Say Uncle
videos.overview: In this non-canon episode, Uncle Grandpa arrives to aid Steven in unlocking the power of his gem.

videos.title: Story for Steven
videos.overview: Greg tells Steven the story of when he first met Rose Quartz.

videos.title: Shirt Club
videos.overview: Steven and Buck make T-shirts.

videos.title: Love Letters
videos.overview: When Jamie the mailman falls in love with Garnet, Steven and Connie must help turn him down gently.

videos.title: Reformed
videos.overview: Amethyst keeps trying to find a new form to regenerate into while she, Steven and Garnet chase after a monster loose in the Temple.

videos.title: Sworn to the Sword
videos.overview: Wanting to protect Steven, Connie takes up swordfighting lessons with Pearl.

videos.title: Rising Tides, Crashing Skies
videos.overview: Ronaldo investigates the Crystal Gems in a web documentary for his "Keep Beach City Weird" blog.

videos.title: Keeping it Together
videos.overview: While the Crystal Gems chase after Peridot in the Kindergarten, Steven and Garnet discover a dark secret while exploring its inner workings.

videos.title: We Need to Talk
videos.overview: After witnessing Steven and Connie fuse again, Greg explains to them how he learned about gem fusion from his time with Rose Quartz, hoping to pull it off himself in order to grow closer to her.

videos.title: Chille Tid
videos.overview: Garnet has Pearl and Amethyst stay with Steven, who is exhausted from searching for Malachite in the ocean with the Gems, for a slumber party. However, Steven is rattled by recurring dreams of Lapis Lazuli.

videos.title: Cry for Help
videos.overview: When TV broadcasts are disrupted by a video signal emitted by Peridot from a Gem communication tower, Garnet chooses to fuse with Pearl into Sardonyx to destroy it, which dismays Amethyst. As the tower keeps being fixed, however, Steven and Amethyst are shocked to discover who's really behind it.

videos.title: Keystone Motel
videos.overview: While she accompanies Greg and Steven on a road trip to another state and a visit to a motel in that state, Garnet's frustration with what Pearl did in the previous episode causes her to split into Ruby and Sapphire.

videos.title: Onion Friend
videos.overview: When they visit Onion's house, Amethyst rekindles her friendship with his mother, Vidalia, while he shows Steven around his room.

videos.title: Historical Friction
videos.overview: Steven is asked by Jamie to participate in a play funded by Mayor Dewey about Beach City's founding, with Pearl stepping in to provide a more historically accurate script.

videos.title: Friend Ship
videos.overview: After the recent events, Pearl wants to redeem herself by capturing Peridot, who traps the Crystal Gems in an old, abandoned Gem spaceship.

videos.title: Nightmare Hospital
videos.overview: Steven and Connie must sneak into a hospital to retrieve Rose Quartz's sword from Connie's mother.

videos.title: Sadie's Song
videos.overview: Steven helps Sadie with an act for the annual Beach City Beach-a-Palooza.

videos.title: Catch and Release
videos.overview: The Crystal Gems finally capture Peridot, but Steven suspects that she knows something and lets her live in his bathroom.

videos.title: When It Rains
videos.overview: After Steven explains Earth's workings, including rainstorms, to Peridot, she takes Steven to the Kindergarten to tell him more about the Cluster.

videos.title: Back to the Barn
videos.overview: The Crystal Gems and Peridot go to the family barn to build a gem drill that can take them to the Cluster's location. However, when Peridot and Pearl fight over who will lead the project, Steven suggests they build robots and compete with each other.

videos.title: Too Far
videos.overview: Peridot gets carried away with gem gossip, and unintentionally really hurts Amethyst's feelings.

videos.title: The Answer
videos.overview: Garnet finally tells Steven the story of how she came to be a Crystal Gem.

videos.title: Steven's Birthday
videos.overview: Steven has a birthday party out at the barn, and decides he has some growing up to do.

videos.title: It Could've Been Great
videos.overview: The Gems take a trip to the moon.

videos.title: Message Received
videos.overview: Steven has doubts about believing in everyone.

videos.title: Log Date 7 15 2
videos.overview: Steven sneaks a listen to a friend’s audio diary.

videos.title: Super Watermelon Island
videos.overview: Steven discovers what happened to his sentient watermelons.

videos.title: Gem Drill
videos.overview: Steven travels deep underground.

videos.title: Same Old World
videos.overview: Steven and Lapis Lazuli go on an adventure.

videos.title: Barn Mates
videos.overview: Steven helps two friends get along at the barn.

videos.title: Hit the Diamond
videos.overview: When an envoy of Rubies arrive, Steven proposes a game of baseball.

videos.title: Steven Floats
videos.overview: Steven discovers he has a new power while seeking a fresh doughnut.

videos.title: Drop Beat Dad
videos.overview: Steven helps Sour Cream put on a show.

videos.title: Mr. Greg
videos.overview: Steven visits Empire City with Greg and Pearl.

videos.title: Too Short to Ride
videos.overview: Steven and Amethyst take a trip to Funland but run into trouble when their friend is too short to ride the rollercoasters.

videos.title: The New Lars
videos.overview: Steven gets a new look into Lars' life.

videos.title: Beach City Drift
videos.overview: Steven and Connie get into a high-speed car race with their biggest foe.

videos.title: Restaurant Wars
videos.overview: Steven settles a rivalry between restaurant owners.

videos.title: Kiki’s Pizza Delivery Service
videos.overview: Kiki has nightmares and Steven intervenes.

videos.title: Monster Reunion
videos.overview: An old friend returns.

videos.title: Alone at Sea
videos.overview: Steven and Greg take Lapis on a boat trip out to sea and find themselves in dangerous water.

videos.title: Greg the Babysitter
videos.overview: Greg tells Steven the story of the time he and Rose babysat Sour Cream for Vidalia.

videos.title: Gem Hunt
videos.overview: Steven, Pearl and Connie go to the Great North to hunt down a corrupted gem.

videos.title: Crack the Whip
videos.overview: Amethyst looks after Steven and Connie while Pearl and Garnet look for Jasper's whereabouts.

videos.title: Steven vs. Amethyst
videos.overview: Steven And Amethyst compete against each other while training with Pearl.

videos.title: Bismuth
videos.overview: Steven discovers something the Gems thought was lost to the past inside of Lion's mane.

videos.title: Beta
videos.overview: Steven and Amethyst visit some friends in the country but Amethyst isn't being herself.

videos.title: Earthlings
videos.overview: Amethyst tries to exact revenge with a showdown in the Kindergarten.

videos.title: Back to the Moon
videos.overview: Steven and the Gems revisit the Moon Base.

videos.title: Bubbled
videos.overview: Steven gets marooned in his bubble.

videos.title: Kindergarten Kid
videos.overview: Steven and Peridot attempt to catch an elusive speedy corrupted Gem monster in the Beta Kindergarten.

videos.title: Know Your Fusion
videos.overview: Steven and the Gems examine fusions.

videos.title: Buddy's Book
videos.overview: Steven visits the library with Connie and uncovers a long lost book.

videos.title: Mindful Education
videos.overview: Steven and Connie learn to focus better.

videos.title: Future Boy Zoltron
videos.overview: Steven tells people's fortunes at Funland.

videos.title: Last One Out of Beach City
videos.overview: Pearl, Steven and Amethyst go to a rock show.

videos.title: Onion Gang
videos.overview: Steven learns about Onion's secret group of friends.

videos.title: Gem Harvest
videos.overview: In this double episode Steven’s autumn visit to the barn brings a new stranger into his life.

videos.title: Three Gems and a Baby
videos.overview: Greg tells Steven about their first winter together

videos.title: Steven's Dream
videos.overview: A strange dream prompts Steven to search for answers.

videos.title: Adventures in Light Distortion
videos.overview: Steven and the Gems take off on a search and recovery mission.

videos.title: Gem Heist
videos.overview: The Gems reach a space station that once belonged to Pink Diamond, and sneak in to rescue Greg, but in order to do so, they must play the roles they were made for, so as not to arouse suspicion.

videos.title: The Zoo
videos.overview: Steven finds Greg in Pink Diamond's "Human Zoo", and tries to look for a way out. This proves easier said than done as the humans there are guided through a strictly scheduled and regimented life

videos.title: That Will Be All
videos.overview: While Blue Diamond and Yellow Diamond argue over their diverging ways of coping with Pink Diamond's death, Steven, Greg and the Crystal Gems attempt to escape the space station before they are discovered.

videos.title: The New Crystal Gems
videos.overview: Connie tells Steven the story of how she, Peridot, and Lapis attempted to take the Crystal Gems' places as the protectors of Beach City while he was in space.

videos.title: Storm in the Room
videos.overview: Steven uses his room in the temple to create a simulated image of Rose Quartz in order to try to experience what it would be like to know his mother. He ends up confronting her with his troubled feelings about her complex legacy and her choice to create him.

videos.title: Rocknaldo
videos.overview: Ronaldo decides to join the Crystal Gems. However, once Steven lets him join the team, Ronaldo's self-centered attitude begins to try Steven's patience.

videos.title: Tiger Philanthropist
videos.overview: When Amethyst quits wrestling at the abandoned warehouse, Steven continues doing so himself as Tiger Philanthropist. However, Steven soon begins to doubt the point of wrestling when the audience doesn't take to his new persona.

videos.title: Room for Ruby
videos.overview: "Navy", one of the Rubies who came to Earth to find Jasper, crashes on Earth and is welcomed in by Steven to be a Crystal Gem. However, Lapis Lazuli does not trust Navy's overly optimistic nature, knowing of her previous encounters with her.

videos.title: Lion 4: Alternate Ending
videos.overview: Steven tries to search for secret messages Rose may have left him about his "magical destiny". Lion eventually leads him to a tape—but it's just an alternate version of the message from Rose he's already seen.

videos.title: Doug Out
videos.overview: Steven and Connie join Connie's father on a stake out.

videos.title: The Good Lars
videos.overview: Steven, Lars and Sadie get invited to a party with the Cool Kids.

videos.title: Are You My Dad?
videos.overview: People disappearing from Beach City, and Steven tries to solve the mystery.

videos.title: I Am My Mom
videos.overview: Steven struggles to fix his mistakes.

videos.title: Stuck Together
videos.overview: Steven and Lars are stuck inside Topaz and try to look for a way to escape.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: Steven goes to court against Blue and Yellow Diamond to determine his (or rather Rose Quartz's) fate.

videos.title: Off Colors
videos.overview: After escaping from the Diamonds, Steven and Lars encounter and befriend the "off-colors", a group of "defective" Gems who live in hiding from Gem society. Lars defends them from security robots but is critically injured in the process.

videos.title: Lars' Head
videos.overview: After Steven brings Lars back to life with his healing powers, he discovers that Lars now shares the same powers as Lion.

videos.title: Dewey Wins
videos.overview: Steven helps Mayor Dewey run a difficult campaign.

videos.title: Gemcation
videos.overview: Greg and the Gems take Steven on vacation to help him relax.

videos.title: Raising the Barn
videos.overview: Pumpkin goes missing.

videos.title: Back to the Kindergarten
videos.overview: Steven, Amethyst, and Peridot try to spruce up the Kindergarten.

videos.title: Sadie Killer
videos.overview: Steven and the Cool Kids start a band, but they have trouble finding their sound.

videos.title: Kevin Party
videos.overview: Kevin is throwing a party, and Steven is invited.

videos.title: Lars of the Stars
videos.overview: Lars rises to the occasion.

videos.title: Jungle Moon
videos.overview: Stevonnie finds themself alone on an adventure.

videos.title: Your Mother and Mine
videos.overview: Steven takes Garnet to meet some of his new friends.

videos.title: The Big Show
videos.overview: Steven shoots a documentary that follows a local band as they get their first big break.

videos.title: Pool Hopping
videos.overview: Garnet and Steven explore the most unlikely timelines in Beach City.

videos.title: Letters to Lars
videos.overview: Steven writes about the latest news of Beach City.

videos.title: Can't Go Back
videos.overview: Ronaldo spots something mysterious on the moon, and Steven goes to investigate.

videos.title: A Single Pale Rose
videos.overview: Steven helps Pearl find her cell phone.

videos.title: Now We're Only Falling Apart
videos.overview: Followed by hearing about the revelation, many problems ensue within the crystal gems' relationships.

videos.title: What's Your Problem?
videos.overview: Amethyst convinces Steven to take a break after all he's been through.

videos.title: The Question
videos.overview: Ruby decides to explore her own life separate from Sapphire, and has a Wild West adventure as a lonesome cowboy with the help of Steven, Amethyst, and Greg.

videos.title: Made of Honor
videos.overview: As Ruby and Sapphire plan their wedding, Sapphire wishes that their friends from the war could be there to see it.

videos.title: Reunited
videos.overview: The wedding of Ruby and Sapphire, with the Gems and several Beach City citizens in attendance, goes without a hitch and Garnet reforms.

videos.title: Legs From Here to Homeworld
videos.overview: Steven tells Blue and Yellow Diamond that their final attack on the Earth corrupted the remaining Gems on the planet, instead of destroying them outright as intended.

videos.title: Familiar
videos.overview: White Diamond believes that Steven is Pink Diamond, so Steven tries to fit Pink's part so that way he can get close enough to White to ask her about helping the corrupted gems on Earth.

videos.title: Together Alone
videos.overview: Steven throws a party to bring his family together.

videos.title: Escapism
videos.overview: Steven uses his psychic powers to find help.

videos.title: Change Your Mind
videos.overview: Steven faces his biggest challenge yet.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 13 wins & 34 nominations total
